quality: Capture and hash original pages and observed receipt times
Exact RTH grids, duplicate conflicts, finite positive OHLC, nonnegative volume
Prior-close and eight as-of feature prefixes; no filling missing data
Compare existing five-day overlap without overwriting old captures

ibkr_scope: FIVE_YEARS ONE_DAY API has no end date. Discard price rows after 2024-10-18 before saving. Retain only in-range price comparisons and action metadata needed to understand retrospective split adjustment. Not training inputs.

acceptance_unchanged: May/July/September 2026 full-account net monthly arithmetic mean >=10%; all May-September months nonnegative. Daily training uses only fully matured labels. No model acceptance claimed in this data stage.
before_training: Independent data audit and a new model preregistration required. Isolate history length from normalized-weight total and regularization strength; show effective sample size. Old results remain unchanged.
